# Image-aligned premium UX
Use the user-approved reference: big FITMATCH AI headline, six pain-gap visual entry cards (space, budget, goal, noise, experience, equipment), glowing understand/match/discover/rank funnel, three five-slot solution columns, agentic workflow footer.

Preserve working interactions, responsive screens from 390px mobile to 1440px desktop, keyboard focus, accessible text, reduced-motion handling, and legible labels. Avoid decorative controls.

Five slots can mean eligible affiliate offers, clearly marked real-source UNVERIFIED research candidates, or free/actionable advice. NEVER show false purchases, fake star ratings, fit scores, affiliate-ready badges, retailer stock or unproven noise and dimensions.

Visually inspect full-page screenshots, no overflow and contrast issues. Verify product images have fallback and all chosen pain-gap options change actual recommendations.
